use_cases.title: Place an order as a guest
use_cases.description: A visitor completes the bouquet purchase flow without creating an account, chooses a delivery date that excludes Sundays, finishes checkout as a guest, and after a successful order sees an order confirmation with an order number while Sarah receives the order by email; the source also requires this full flow to work on a phone because most customers arrive from Instagram.
use_cases.summary: Complete guest checkout for bouquet orders
use_cases.value: Captures orders and revenue without staff involvement while fitting one-off buyers who do not want an account.

use_cases.title: Add an available bouquet to the basket
use_cases.description: A visitor adds a bouquet to the basket only when that bouquet is in stock, sees the basket total update to reflect what was added, and can perform this basket step on a phone as part of the storefront flow.
use_cases.summary: Add in-stock bouquets to the basket
use_cases.value: Lets customers build an order accurately while preventing baskets that Sarah cannot fulfill.

use_cases.description: A visitor browses the bouquet catalogue, sees the price of every bouquet before deciding whether to add anything to the basket, and can do that browsing on a phone so ordering is possible outside staffed shop hours.
use_cases.value: Helps customers self-serve product discovery and purchase decisions without calling or messaging the shop.
